# <:green_dot:1473389051565310246> Search A Location

 To teleport to a specific location, just search it in the search bar and click on the result. You will be teleported to the location you selected.

<:green_ring:1473389065389867101> You can search for a specific coordinate, a city, or a region.
<:green_ring:1473389065389867101> You can also search for a specific player by typing their username.
